title: Jazzy Gooey Australian Thai Chicken Noodles
description: A floral and gooey Australian dish featuring Thai holy basil krapao and tandoor flavors, perfect for a sick day, and diabetic friendly.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the grated ginger, Thai holy basil, tandoor spice mix, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for 1 minute, until the basil is wilted.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and gochujang sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Cook the low carb noodles according to the package instructions and drain.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken and sauce.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Serve the Jazzy Gooey Australian Thai Chicken Noodles hot, garnished with additional Thai holy basil if desired.
